root_cause.text: The `hbh_mt6_check()` function in the ip6t_hbh netfilter module fails to validate the user-supplied `optsnr` field against the maximum allowed `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` (16), allowing an oversized value that leads to an out-of-bounds array access when the fixed-size `opts[]` array is indexed beyond its bounds during packet matching.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR)` returning `-EINVAL`, and the CVE description reports a UBSAN error "index 16 is out of range for type '__u16 [16]'" at line 110 of ip6t_hbh.c, confirming the off-by-one out-of-bounds access.
